subject.title: Add opt-in Tailscale Serve with tailnet identity authentication for generated WSL gateways

question: Should generated WSL gateways offer a first-party opt-in mode where tailnet identity and ACLs authorize gateway access alongside existing token and device credentials?
rationale: Existing code supports connecting to externally managed Tailscale endpoints, but the issue asks core setup to provision a third-party network and add a new gateway authorization boundary; source inspection cannot determine that product and security intent.

options.title: Approve a staged core design
options.body: Define the authorization contract, prerequisite checks, rollback behavior, secret handling, and compatibility invariants before splitting implementation into focused setup and recovery changes.

options.title: Keep Tailscale user-managed
options.body: Continue accepting HTTPS/WSS tailnet endpoints while documenting external Tailscale Serve setup and leaving identity authorization outside generated-gateway provisioning.

recommendation.title: Approve a staged core design
recommendation.body: Define the authorization contract, prerequisite checks, rollback behavior, secret handling, and compatibility invariants before splitting implementation into focused setup and recovery changes.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor has the strongest combined history across setup configuration, gateway authentication defaults, and existing Tailscale endpoint behavior.
